waivers.G-FALSIFIER-COVERAGE: the coverage gate counts itself inside its own denominator, so a falsifier for it would have to be a falsifier of the count that contains it; the forcing is that its own identifier is a member of the denominator it divides by, checked here
waivers.G-FALSIFIER-MOVES: a falsifier of the move-proof gate would have to be proved to move by the very gate it falsifies; the forcing is that the gate demonstrably evaluated every declared falsifier, checked by requiring one move proof per declared row

direct_limit.the_form: A HOR-LAW IS A STATEMENT OF THE FORM: FOR EVERY FINITE OPEN PATCH P AND EVERY OBSERVABLE O WHOSE SUPPORT AND WHOSE DEPTH-CONE BOTH LIE INSIDE P, PHI(O) HOLDS.  NO SYMBOL IN A HOR-LAW DENOTES A SIZE, NO QUANTIFIER RANGES OVER A COMPLETED TOTALITY, AND EVERY INSTANCE IS A STATEMENT ABOUT ONE FINITE PATCH.  THE PATCHES FORM A DIRECTED SYSTEM UNDER INCLUSION AND THE INCLUSIONS CARRY VALUES UNCHANGED ON THE OBSERVABLES A HOR-LAW QUANTIFIES OVER; THAT PROPERTY IS WHAT THE UNIT MEASURES, AND IT IS NOT A CONVERGENCE, NOT A LIMIT AND NOT AN OBJECT.
